name: NHS — autism assessments
description: NHS public information on seeking an autism assessment, what adult and child assessments can involve, waiting, outcomes, second opinions and England Right to Choose.
intended_use: Use as the national England-facing starting route for how adults or children can seek an NHS autism assessment and what the process may involve.
audience_or_context: Adults, children and young people, families and supporters in England navigating NHS autism assessment.
limitations: The page is general national information and local referral routes, eligibility arrangements and waits vary.
Right to Choose is an England NHS route and must not be presented as a Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland entitlement.
The page cannot establish whether a particular person is autistic.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; NHS assessment access depends on current eligibility and local service arrangements.
conflicts_of_interest: The NHS publishes information about NHS pathways it operates; ND Oracle records the official route without assuming local availability or individual outcome.

provenance.method: Current NHS page checked on 2026-09-03 for referral, waiting, assessment, outcome, second-opinion and England Right to Choose wording. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
